name: Chat history, selection — all
summary: Every row ticked. Select all comes out of the nav, leaving Cancel alone, and the button stops counting: it reads Delete all chats.

looseEnds.title: The button stops counting at full
looseEnds.detail: At two and three the button names a number; at four it reads 'Delete all chats'. The user therefore loses the count at the point the action is most destructive, and the confirmation they land on is a different one from the counted path.
looseEnds.ask: Should full selection read 'Delete 4 chats' and keep one confirmation, or is the all-chats wording deliberate?

looseEnds.title: The nav group collapses to one button
looseEnds.detail: The action group shrinks from 267px at x=102 to 123px at x=246 so that Cancel stays flush right. Nothing is drawn for the transition, so Cancel appears to jump.
looseEnds.ask: Confirm Cancel holds its position while Select all leaves.
